title: B2 Milestone 2: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado el Segundo Hito del Nivel B2. Controlas la gramática avanzada para discursos y posees un léxico financiero y gerencial impecable.

parts.visual:
En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 6 a 9 del nivel B2: 
- Inversión y Énfasis (Never have I seen...). 
- Pasiva con verbos de reporte (It is said that / He is expected to).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 6 to 9 of the B2 level: Inversion and Emphasis, and the Passive Voice with reporting verbs.

parts.visual:
También repasaremos vocabulario crítico de negocios: 
- Manejo de Crisis (Damage control, tackle, root cause). 
- Finanzas Avanzadas (Assets, liabilities, ROI, bear market). 
¡Demuestra que eres un experto!
parts.audio: We will also review critical business vocabulary: Crisis Management, and Advanced Finance. Show that you are an expert!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador B2.

questions.question: Never before ____ such a huge financial loss. (Habíamos visto).
questions.explanation: Inversión en pasado perfecto: had we seen.

questions.question: Not only ____ the budget, but she also finished early. (No solo aprobó ella).
questions.explanation: Inversión en pasado simple: did she approve.

questions.question: ____ is expected that the company will go public. (Se espera).
questions.explanation: Pasiva impersonal: It is expected that...

questions.question: The CEO is expected ____ his resignation today. (A anunciar).
They are reported ____ millions last year. (Haber perdido).
questions.explanation: To have + participio (para acciones ya ocurridas).

questions.question: The PR team had to do ____ control after the scandal. (Control de daños).
We must ____ the problem immediately. (Abordar/atacar).
We need a ____ plan in case the server fails. (Plan de contingencia).
Our total ____ include real estate and cash. (Activos).
We need to pay off our ____. (Pasivos/Deudas).
The company decided to ____ public next month. (Salir a bolsa).
Under no circumstances ____ the password. (Debes compartir).
questions.explanation: Inversión con modal: should you share.

questions.question: It ____ rumored that the banks will merge. (Se rumorea).
We had to take ____ measures to avoid bankruptcy. (Medidas drásticas).
What is the ____ cause of this error? (Causa raíz).
He has to ____ the music and accept his mistake. (Enfrentar las consecuencias).
In a ____ market, investors are pessimistic and prices fall. (Mercado bajista).
The company had to file for ____. (Bancarrota).
All the ____ must be informed about the decision. (Partes interesadas).
Little ____ about the new regulations. (Sabíamos nosotros).
questions.explanation: Inversión en pasado: did we know.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave del nivel B2.

questions.question: Never ____ I seen this. (He yo)
Not only ____ she win. (Hizo ella en pasado)
____ is expected that prices will rise. (Pronombre)
He is said ____ be a genius. (Preposición)
Damage ____. (Control con C)
The ____ cause. (Causa raíz con R)
Company ____. (Activos con A plural)
Company ____. (Pasivos con L plural)
To ____ public. (Salir a bolsa con G)
A ____ market. (Mercado bajista con B)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración para tu examen final del bloque 2.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Never have I seen such a crisis.
options: Never have I seen such a crisis.
Never I have seen such a crisis.
I have never seen such a crisis.
Never have I see such a crisis.
questions.correct_answer: Never have I seen such a crisis.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Not only did we win, but we got a bonus.
options: Not only did we win, but we got a bonus.
Not only we won, but we got a bonus.
Not only do we win, but we got a bonus.
Not only did we won, but we got a bonus.
questions.correct_answer: Not only did we win, but we got a bonus.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It is expected that profits will fall.
options: It is expected that profits will fall.
It expects that profits will fall.
It is expected profits will fall.
Is expected that profits will fall.
questions.correct_answer: It is expected that profits will fall.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The CEO is expected to resign.
options: The CEO is expected to resign.
The CEO is expected that he resigns.
The CEO is expecting to resign.
questions.correct_answer: The CEO is expected to resign.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to do damage control.
options: We need to do damage control.
We need to do error control.
They need to do damage control.
questions.correct_answer: We need to do damage control.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to reduce our liabilities.
options: We need to reduce our liabilities.
We need to reduce our debts.
We need to produce our liabilities.
They need to reduce their liabilities.
questions.correct_answer: We need to reduce our liabilities.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The company decided to go public.
options: The company decided to go public.
The company wants to go public.
The company refused to go public.
questions.correct_answer: The company decided to go public.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It is a bear market right now.
options: It is a bear market right now.
It is a bull market right now.
It is a bad market right now.
Is it a bear market right now?
questions.correct_answer: It is a bear market right now.
